programme.title: Newsday
programme.desc: "Good Morning Asia, hello World." Join the news teams from BBC World News in London and Singapore. This live news and current affairs program is broadcast globally and focuses on all the latest news and breaking developing stories that matter around the world. The show is usually presented by Rico Hizon in Singapore and Kasia Madera in London. Broadcasting live at midnight GMT on both BBC World News and the BBC News channel, the show is broadcast in the morning in Asia and therefore is marketed as a morning show for people watching around the country. The show is often followed by Asia Business Report live from Singapore which reports on all the latest economy and business figures from the country.

programme.title: BBC World News America
programme.desc: News presenter Katty Kay keeps you up to date with all the latest breaking news from America and the rest of the world on BBC World News America. This world renowned news and current affairs program has been recognised for its exceptional reporting at the Emmy Awards. BBC World News America won two Emmy awards for its coverage of the conflicts in Syria and the Central African Republic. You can catch up with this award winning broadcast team as they air multiple times a day throughout the week.

programme.title: Newsnight
programme.desc: In-depth news and current affairs review of the main political and economic stories of the day, featuring robust interviews with senior government and opposition figures, business and union leaders, and analytical reports that delve behind the headlines. Regular presenters cross-examine studio guests on details of policies, priorities, actions and inactions, on a range of domestic UK and international topics. There are weekly features on the arts, sports and the world of technology, and editors are not afraid to venture into niche, specialist and exotic areas from space travel to animal psychology. If the BBC's flagship Radio 4 Today programme sets the early morning news agenda for the day, then its late-night TV equivalent often gives the people in power some sleepless nights.

programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G3. Zalgiris Kaunas - Fenerbahce
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: La Vuelta Femenina Stage 5 | León - Astorga (119km)
Myrtle Beach Classic | Day 1 PGA Tour
Глобал
programme.desc: Тележурнал об экологии, возможностях и рисках глобализации. Мы живем в глобальном мире, где, например, климатические изменения тропических лесов Амазонки оказывают влияние на жизнь в Европе. Программа предоставляет дайджесты новейших исследований по вопросам глобализации и экологии, ищет решение для глобальных последствий локальных действий - и наоборот, рассказывает о положительном опыте и примерах в сфере экологии, аграрной или промышленной деятельности других стран.

programme.title: Характер: Спортсмен
programme.desc: Во время агрессии на Украину российские солдаты убили более 400 украинских спортсменов. Сотни стадионов, спортивных центров, залов и бассейнов были разрушены. Тысячи молодых спортсменов и детей бежали за границу, спасаясь от войны. Ровно через два года после начала полномасштабного российского вторжения в Украину документальный фильм "Характер: Спортсмен" исследует последствия войны для украинского спорта, спортсменов и спортивной инфраструктуры.

programme.title: Комбайнерша
programme.desc: Раньше Жамиля работала продавщицей в магазине. Позже она взяла в аренду 50 гектаров земли и стала фермершей. Свой первый трактор она купила в 1999 году в кредит за миллион сомов. Тогда никто не верил, что 50-летняя женщина сможет вести дела и выплатить кредит на такую большую сумму.

programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Что мы на самом деле знаем о Дмитрии Медведеве? Питерский юрист, неприметный сотрудник мэрии, который на короткое время стал надеждой страны на либеральные перемены и становлении в России настоящей демократии, а ныне один из самых желчных ненавистников и критиков как Украины, так и западного мира. Отсчет истории Дмитрия Медведева начинается с 1980-х годов, когда он учился на юрфаке Ленинградского государственного университета. Кем Медведев работал в команде Анатолия Собчака? Когда и где встретился с Владимиром Путиным? Как стал президентом России? И почему превратился в одиозного ястреба-милитариста (по крайней мере, на словах)? В этом видео мы расскажем о взлете и падении бывшего президента России и личного протеже Путина Дмитрия Медведева.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.title: Наизнанку
programme.desc: В этом видео обсуждаем свежий доклад Центра стратегических и международных исследований (CSIS). Ведущий эксперт по безопасности и один из авторов доклада Сет Джонс в интервью "Idel.Реалии" раскрывает детали исследования. Среди прочего в исследовании рассматриваются человеческие потери и экономические последствия. По его словам, с начала 2024 года российские войска продвинулись менее чем на 1,5% украинской территории, несут огромные потери и сталкиваются с серьёзными экономическими проблемами. Джонс также объяснил, как авторы доклада получали данные о погибших, почему Кремль терпит стратегические поражения, как война влияет на регионы и технологическое отставание России, а также что может ждать страну после Путина.

programme.desc: Программа о событиях в Крыму.

programme.title: Узбекистан. Сториз
programme.desc: После многих лет изоляции в 2018 году Узбекистан наконец открылся миру и документалистам. Однако все еще остались места, о которых практически никто не знает. В проекте "Узбекистан. Сторис" молодые узбекские режиссеры покажут скрытые сокровища далеких уголков своей страны, к которым почти невозможно добраться. А также расскажут истории необычных людей, встретившихся им на пути. Герои сериала - фотографы, молодые ученые, рэперы, исполнители национального фольклора, спортсмены и рыбаки.

programme.title: Характер: Спортсмен
programme.desc: Во время агрессии на Украину российские солдаты убили более 400 украинских спортсменов. Сотни стадионов, спортивных центров, залов и бассейнов были разрушены. Тысячи молодых спортсменов и детей бежали за границу, спасаясь от войны. Ровно через два года после начала полномасштабного российского вторжения в Украину документальный фильм "Характер: Спортсмен" исследует последствия войны для украинского спорта, спортсменов и спортивной инфраструктуры.

programme.title: Комбайнерша
programme.desc: Раньше Жамиля работала продавщицей в магазине. Позже она взяла в аренду 50 гектаров земли и стала фермершей. Свой первый трактор она купила в 1999 году в кредит за миллион сомов. Тогда никто не верил, что 50-летняя женщина сможет вести дела и выплатить кредит на такую большую сумму.

programme.title: Утро
programme.desc: Программа "Утро" каждый будний день открывает информационную линейку телеканала "Настоящее Время". "Утро" выходит в прямом эфире из киевской студии и рассказывает зрителям о том, что им надо знать в самом начале дня. Главные новости, основные события наступающего дня, самые важные темы для обсуждения - в утренних эфирах каждый день.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Главные фигуры
programme.desc: Что мы на самом деле знаем о Дмитрии Медведеве? Питерский юрист, неприметный сотрудник мэрии, который на короткое время стал надеждой страны на либеральные перемены и становлении в России настоящей демократии, а ныне один из самых желчных ненавистников и критиков как Украины, так и западного мира. Отсчет истории Дмитрия Медведева начинается с 1980-х годов, когда он учился на юрфаке Ленинградского государственного университета. Кем Медведев работал в команде Анатолия Собчака? Когда и где встретился с Владимиром Путиным? Как стал президентом России? И почему превратился в одиозного ястреба-милитариста (по крайней мере, на словах)? В этом видео мы расскажем о взлете и падении бывшего президента России и личного протеже Путина Дмитрия Медведева.

programme.title: Азия 360
programme.desc: Что вы знаете о Центральной Азии? То, что эти страны когда-то входили в состав СССР, и то, что люди сейчас там живут бедно, живут в кишлаках и ездят на ослах, мечтают переехать в Россию и работать там, пьют только зеленый чай и едят плов и мясо, притесняют людей других национальностей? Мы решили развеять самые распространенные мифы о Центральной Азии, а также рассказать о забытых традициях и блюдах, которые шокируют иностранцев, а иногда даже самих местных.

programme.desc: Программа о бизнесе с человеческим лицом. Захватывающие экономические репортажи из сердца Европы. К примеру, авторы рассказывают о рисках и преимуществах цифровых технологий в быстро меняющемся мире, а также об их влиянии на то, как мы работаем, что мы зарабатываем и как мы живем. Топ-менеджеры, креативные бизнесмены и молодые специалисты, новые тренды и традиции немецкого бизнеса - все это Made in Germany.

programme.title: Азия
programme.desc: Информационная программа "Азия" знакомит с новостями центральноазиатского региона – Казахстана, Кыргызстана, Таджикистана, Туркменистана и Узбекистана. Это эксклюзивные репортажи и расследования, интервью с независимыми журналистами и гражданскими активистами, политиками и правозащитниками. Материалы наших корреспондентов часто являются альтернативой официальным сообщениям.

programme.title: Нью-Йорк New York
programme.desc: Нью-Йорк, New York - воскресный видеожурнал о городе большого яблока и его обитателях. Что надо увидеть, узнать, съесть, надеть и... понять о Нью-Йорке. Ведущие Елена Мещерякова и Евгений Маслов покажут вам места, ставшие символами города, и объяснят, почему они до сих пор сохраняют свою важность. Мы прогуляемся по Центральному парку и Таймс-сквер, зайдем на Центральный вокзал и поднимемся на Эмпайр-стейт-билдинг. Вы познакомитесь с личными историями ньюйоркцев, которым есть что рассказать. А еще вам будет интересно узнать о странных нью-йоркских привычках, будь то плавание в ледяной воде или игра на бочках.

События, явления и люди в репортажах корреспондентов Настоящего Времени, работающих в регионе. programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Но с 2022-го года все изменилось. Россия буквально изо дня в день становилась все менее известной — и для мира, и для себя самой. Голоса тех, кого и раньше почти не было слышно — людей, живших в отдаленных уголках нашей страны и имевших собственное мнение о происходящем вокруг, а именно они, как правило, и становились героями наших выпусков — так вот, голоса этих людей сегодня практически стихли. Да и обитатели крупных городов теперь тоже живут во вполне себе неизвестной России. Они стараются держать свои мысли и переживания при себе. Лишь догадываясь, о чем на самом деле сегодня думает остальная страна.

Мы показываем Америку глазами человека, которому нужно строить свою жизнь заново, искать свое место в пока еще чуждом для него мире. Сравниваем цены на продукты и топливо, говорим о политике, работе и учебе.

Они обе думали, что никогда не расскажут о случившемся, но решили нарушить молчание, чтобы изменить отношение к пострадавшим и не дать военным преступникам остаться безнаказанными.

programme.title: Неизвестная Россия
programme.desc: Оймякон — самое холодное село не только в России, но и на всей планете. Минус 60 здесь обычное дело. И хотя находится этот населенный пункт гораздо ближе к Колыме и Хабаровскому краю, нежели, например, к Северному полюсу, именно Оймякон, а не самая северная точка планеты, является "полюсом холода". Приехать в Оймякон, погостить несколько дней, как следует утеплившись и укутавшись в теплую одежду, — уже подвиг. Не говоря о том, чтобы иметь здесь постоянную прописку. Жить и работать без выходных. Не обращая внимания на показания термометра

programme.title: Перекресток
programme.desc: Сериал, состоящий из короткометражных документальных фильмов, посвященных сложным темам в странах Восточной Европы и Ближнего Востока. Это aвторский взгляд на проблемы и перспективы этих регионов. Настоящая жизнь крупным планом.

programme.title: VOTVOT
programme.desc: Votvot характеризует себя как платформу для свободного выражения мнений для широкой аудитории, в том числе для молодежи, интересующейся альтернативами традиционным новостным программам. На платформе можно найти среди прочего документальные фильмы, театральные постановки, концерты, детские образовательные программы.

programme.title: Dead Man's Shoes
programme.desc: Shane Meadows' thriller is set in a small, bleak Derbyshire town. After seven years in the army, Richard (Paddy Considine) returns to find out what happened to his beloved brother Anthony (Toby Kebbell), who latched on to the local drugs cartel and became the butt of their cruelty. As Richard begins to take revenge against the gang, led by Sonny (Gary Stretch), the story of Anthony's life and fate unfolds through flashback and revelations. This screening is introduced by the director.

programme.title: The Lookout
programme.desc: Daniel Auteuil, Mathieu Kassovitz and Olivier Gourmet star in this French crime drama, in which director Michele Placido spins a swiftly moving, complex tale of intrigue and murderous deception. Parisian chief inspector Mattei (Auteuil) believes his carefully prepared sting will finally net a band of persistent bank robbers. But, just as the police operation is reaching its climax, an unseen sniper starts to pick off Mattei's men and, in the blood-drenched confusion, the thieves escape with their loot. Emerging from the carnage, Mattei vows revenge and soon has the suspected killer, Vincent (Kassovitz), in custody. But as his investigation develops further, it becomes clear that it won't be easy to pin the crime on the young man; and he still needs to track down the rest of the gang. Meanwhile, holed-up in the countryside with a doctor (Gourmet) who has been hired to patch them up, the criminals begin to realise that they're far from safe - and it's not the police that they most have to worry about. In French with English subtitles. Film4 premiere.

programme.title: That's What I Am
programme.desc: A coming-of-age story set in 1965 that follows 12-year-old Andy Nichol (Chase Ellison), a bright student who, like most kids his age, will do anything to avoid conflict for fear of suffering overwhelming ridicule and punishment from his junior high school peers. Everyone's favorite teacher, Mr. Simon (Ed Harris), pairs Andy with the school's biggest outcast and social pariah, Stanley, aka "Big G" (Alexander Walters), on a critical term project. Sporting thick orange hair, a head too big for his body and ears too big for his head, "Big G" has been the object of ridicule since grade school. Before long, Andy will learn that there was truly a method behind Mr. Simon's madness as to why he teamed these two up. As the story unfolds, Mr. Simon finds himself the target of a malicious rumor after Principal Kelner (Amy Madigan) suspends a school bully for brutally beating up a female classmate whom he thinks has "cooties."

programme.title: The Painted Veil
programme.desc: In the 1920s a young English couple--Walter a middle class doctor and Kitty an upper-class woman--get married for the wrong reasons and relocate to Shanghai where she falls in love with someone else. When he uncovers her infidelity in an act of vengeance he accepts a job in a remote village in China ravaged by a deadly epidemic and takes her along. Their journey brings meaning to their relationship and gives them purpose in one of the most remote and beautiful places on earth.

programme.title: Millions
programme.desc: The Hoopstars travel to Michigan for a tournament. They get off to a terrible start in their first game, trailing 18-2 at one point. They come back to take the lead with a minute remaining, but wind up losing. They lose the second game of the day on a three-pointer at the buzzer, and also drop a third contest. Coach Douglas remains positive after the first loss, but gradually grows more disappointed with their effort. Many of the girls admit to being distracted. A frustrated Maria avoids her teammates at the hotel that night because it doesn't seem they are taking the losses very seriously. The Hoopstars win their final game of the tournament, but still worry about how they will fare at State.

programme.title: The Fabulous Patars
programme.desc: After the death of his beloved spouse, Denis, a loving father, is struggling with the education of his two daughters, Jenine and Mercredi, and his two jobs. When he forgets to pick Mercredi up from school, the director calls the social services. Severine, a social investigator, forces Denis to attend parenting classes, under penalty of withdrawing the custody of his daughters…

programme.title: The Face of Love
programme.desc: Several years after the death of her husband, a widow meets a stranger who greatly resembles her late husband, from his striking blue eyes to his kindness and humor, and falls in love with him, and, again, meets the love of her life.

programme.title: Waking Ned
programme.desc: The lucky winner of the national lottery is Ned Devine, so taken by his good fortune that he now can't be waked, because he died from the shock of it! News of the win spread quickly in the scenic little Irish village of Tully More, but not the secret news of Ned's demise. With lottery officials closing in to confirm the prize claimed by the deceased Devine, Ned's closest friends scheme to keep the prize money close to home, in memory of Ned of course! But as the plot twists humorously, they learn it is hard is to keep such a secret in a small town.

programme.title: Lou!
programme.desc: Lou spends her days eating takeout, playing with her cat and spying on a hunky neighbor, but when her mom falls in love, her life takes a sudden turn.

programme.title: Bright Star
programme.desc: Drama based on the doomed love affair between Romantic poet John Keats and the young Fanny Brawne. On the outskirts of 19th-century London, John Keats struggles through grinding poverty and constant ill-health to establish himself as a writer, while the young seamstress Fanny Brawne is intrigued by her secretive neighbour and is determined to seek him out. The two begin a blissful three-year romance of lazy summers and slow burning love, until Keats' protective friend Charles Brown grows wary of Brawne. However, this soon proves to be the least of their problems when Keats' health starts to fail badly, beginning the end of the magical love affair.

programme.title: Say Cheese
programme.desc: Thierry's wife Claire wants to leave him. In a desperate effort to save his marriage Thierry ropes in Claire and the two grown-up children to spend a vacation in Greece exactly as they did on a legendary trip 30 years ago.

programme.title: The Truth About Love
programme.desc: Drunk, Archie sends a valentine to his best friend's wife. She sends one to her husband. He hides it so she disguises herself as a slut. Will he cheat on his wife - with his wife? Let us see what happens.

programme.title: Pride
programme.desc: PRIDE is an inspirational comedy based on remarkable true events. It's the summer of 1984 - Margaret Thatcher is in power and the National Union of Mineworkers (NUM) is on strike. At the Gay Pride March in London, a group of gay and lesbian activists decides to raise money to support the families of the striking miners. But there is a problem. The Union seems embarrassed to receive their support. But the activists are not deterred. They decide to ignore the Union and go direct to the miners. They identify a mining village in deepest Wales and set off in a mini bus to make their donation in person. programme.title: Restaurant: Impossible
programme.desc: After combating countless "impossible dinners," Chef Robert Irvine faces a daunting new challenge: save America's most desperate restaurants from impending failure in just two days with only $10,000. In his new prime-time Food Network series, Restaurant: Impossible, Robert uses creativity and resourcefulness along with a lot of muscle in his fight to rescue these restaurants and give hope to the owners and their employees. Day one of the extreme mission begins with a thorough business assessment as Robert launches the restaurant into full service, closely observes the staff and kitchen, and determines their weakest spots. Then, he springs into action by updating the menu, retraining the staff and implementing aesthetic changes with the help of his design team. To ensure a packed house for the grand re-opening at the end of day two, Robert hits the streets to tell the community about the improved restaurant. Will the ruthless schedule, tight budget and ambitious task overcome Robert's lofty goals, or will this tall order result in restaurant triumph?

programme.title: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives
programme.desc: Diners, Drive-Ins and Dives is American food reality television series about places with the most delicious food. The host is American restaurateur Guy Fieri who travels along the USA, Canada or Europe looking for the most fascinating cafes and introduces them to the viewers. Each show has a specific focus on a certain dish, like burgers, pasta, comfort food. Small cafes with traditional food and home-style recipes or ethnic specialties adored by the locals are of particular interest to the host. Guy Fieri enters the kitchen, gets to know the cook, actively takes part in cooking, interacts with the guests and kitchen staff and gives his humorous spicy comments on the process and the food itself.

programme.title: Cooper's Treasure
programme.desc: Considered one of NASA's original space pioneers, astronaut Gordon Cooper discovered something extraordinary on a 1963 mission. While circling Earth during a 122-hour flight to detect nuclear sites, Cooper photographed more than 100 anomalies around the South Caribbean. He later believed the dark patches that appeared on the photos to be sunken ships, and while working for decades in secret, Gordon created a map that he thought could uncover treasures worth billions of dollars. Before passing away, he shared his meticulous research with longtime friend Darrell Miklos, and now Miklos is teaming with seasoned explorers and researchers to finally make good on Gordon's dream.

programme.title: Ice Cold Gold

The six-part series follows eight men who leave behind their families, friends and homeland to strike it rich against all odds while struggling to survive against the harshest of conditions. Greenland's a veritable beast, but the motley crew of ICE COLD GOLD miners is up for the challenge. Each thinks he has what it takes to walk away with gold, rubies and sapphires before winter and large mining companies swoop in. What transpires as the miners cope with the unpredictable, harsh unknown? Are they humbled by their journey? Do their personalities get in the way? Most importantly, do they strike ICE COLD GOLD?ed ice sheets.

The series also explores The Missing Douglas and whether an interdimensional portal in the Alaska Triangle led to the disappearance of the airplane carrying 44 military personnel in 1950.

programme.desc: Documentary series in which host Don Wildman, history enthusiast and adventurer, focuses on interesting and unusual artifacts held in museums, historical institutions, and unexplored archives around the world. programme.title: Mountain Monsters
programme.desc: Mountain Monsters is an American cryptozoology-themed reality TV series revolving around the Appalachian Investigators of Mysterious Sightings team. It is a group of six skilled native West Virginian hunters and trappers. They are on a mission to study and track unidentified creatures in the Appalachian Mountains. Their main goal is to prove that mysterious creatures like Bigfoot, Werewolf, Hellhound, Lizard Man, and Mothman do exist and provide the proper evidence to the viewers.

programme.title: The Holzer Files
programme.desc: Based on the real life files of America's first ghost hunter, Dr. Hans Holzer (whose most famous case concerned the Lutz family of Amityville, NY), this show follows a team of paranormal investigators as they reexamine the terrifying tales that mystified the doctor. The team consists of paranormal investigator Dave Schrader, psychic medium Cindy Kaza and equipment technician Shane Pittman and they are aided by Holzer's daughter, Alexandra. They examine thousands of documents, letters, photographs, and audio and visual recordings, sometimes going as far back as the 50s. Following on from where Holzer left off, the team bring the investigations up to the present day and visit the locations of the supernatural events such as the Peck House, the Morris-Jumel Mansion, the Whaley House, and the USS Constellation.

programme.title: Ghost Brothers
programme.desc: What you see is what you get with Dalen Spratt, Juwan Mass and Marcus Harvey, the Southeast's newest and most dynamic paranormal investigation team. These three best friends lead Destination America's new series GHOST BROTHERS, on a mission to uncover whether some unique, legendary "haunted" houses are the real deal. Raised in religious households, Dalen, Juwan and Marcus were taught that "messing" with the dead is dangerous business, but some unexplained experiences of their own piqued their intense fascination, ultimately driving them to find out firsthand just how spooky the supernatural can be. Blending natural curiosity with comedic flair, these charismatic characters offer a fresh, funny and unique take on the spirit world.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Investigation Discovery and People magazine partner to re-examine some of the most high profile crime cases in recent history. The one-hour series brings viewers tales of betrayal, buried secrets and unsung heroes, ripped from the pages of one of the nation's top weekly magazines. These stories transcended news and became part of pop culture, revealing shocking twists, new evidence, and unexpected resolutions. Interlaced within every episode are exclusive interviews with People's journalists, archival footage, re-creations, and firsthand accounts by those closest to the investigations.

programme.title: Web of Lies
programme.desc: Documentary series that tells true and often tragic stories of the crimes perpetrated on the internet and of deception and manipulation triggered by online interactions - from predators lurking behind Facebook profiles to maniacs searching for their victims in chat rooms. Series includes re-enactments, comments from law enforcement personnel, true-crime experts, psychologists and interviews from friends and families of the victims. Rare episodes feature victims who were extremely lucky to survive and are able to tell us what happened.

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: Allyzibeth Lamont, age 22, who was known as "Ally Lamont" was murdered on October 28, 2019 in the Local No. 9 deli in Johnstown, New York where she had been employed. Her body, buried in a shallow grave, was found by police on October 31, 2019. She had noticed unusual labor law financial dealings by one of the co-owners of the deli, Greek immigrant Georgios Kakavelos, who feared she would report him to the authorities. In the end, both Georgios Kakavelos and Jimmy Duffy (a man Kakavelos hired for $1600 to murder and hide the body) were arrested and charged with her murder. Duffy was sentenced to "18 years to life" in prison. Kakavelos was sentenced to "life in prison without the possibility of parole."

programme.title: People Magazine Investigates
programme.desc: On June 14, 2013, 19-year-old Adrienne Salinas and her two roommates are hosting a party at their apartment in Tempe, Arizona. The party is in full swing when Adrienne suddenly decides to leave. She gets in her car, drives away, and never returns home. In the days that follow, her family and friends work side by side with Tempe PD searching for Adrienne. When her body is discovered in a desert river basin, 35 miles awhile from her Tempe home, investigators suspect foul play. When all of their leads become dead ends, the case goes cold. But two years after Adrienne's body was discovered, a local man calls Tempe PD with a tip that his best friend, known around town as The Zombie Hunter, could be connected to Adrienne's disappearance and mysterious death.

programme.title: True Crime with Aphrodite Jones
programme.desc: Crime documentary series hosted by Aphrodite Jones who looks into real-life crimes including some of the most atrocious murders of recent times. Jones shares details of these gruesome crimes alongside authentic footage, evidence and interviews with people associated to the case – sometimes even the perpetrator themselves. Subjects featured in the series include such high-profile cases as O. J. Simpson, Michael Jackson, the notorious Zodiac serial killer and the music producer Phil Spector. Jones attempts to get inside the minds of her subjects to better understand their motives for committing such unspeakable crimes. Aphrodite Jones is a true-crime expert, a former crime reporter for FOX News and the author of eight books.

programme.title: American Chopper
programme.desc: American Chopper is an American reality television series that revolves around the Teutuls- Paul Senior, his sons Paul Junior and Michael who work together at Orange County Choppers, a custom motorcycle fabrication company located in Montgomery, New York. The series is a mix of competition and drama, famous for real fighting, cursing, crying, welding, and painting. It's indisputable that each Teutul is a gifted mechanic, engineer and designer, they put together a motorbike in front of the viewers and make every customer's wish come true.

programme.title: Shed And Buried: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Shed & Buried: Classic Cars sees Henry team-up with Fuzz Townshend once again. The duo will be doing what they do best: digging in the nation's sheds, barns and outbuildings, this time to (hopefully) find a tidy profit in some vintage motors.

programme.title: Last Chance Garage
programme.desc: Specialty car restoration mistakes are much more common than you'd think, and each episode of LAST CHANCE GARAGE features a car with a horrifying backstory: multiple shops, years lost, and tens of thousands of dollars in sunk costs. On the flip side of that struggle, audiences will see the customer and learn about their unique - and often deeply personal - connection to their car.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers
programme.desc: Buy, repair and restore and then resell a classic car in order to make profit- this is what Wheeler Dealers is about. The budget is limited, though you can see some exclusive and rare cars. Mike Brewer, a British dealer chooses the car carefully and hands it over to the mechanic, first Edd China, later Ant Anstead to be fixed and upgraded. The hosts are real masters of their trade, it seems they can bring life even to a piece of metal. It does not matter if you are a life-long car enthusiast or do not even have a driving license you will admire the results of hard work from the beginning to the end of the long uneasy restoring process.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Meet modern-day treasure hunter Drew Pritchard. With demanding customers, high turnover, and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life!

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: Classic Cars
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard and Paul Cowland travel across the United Kingdom to uncover classic cars to buy, restore and sell on for a profit. The pair scour garages, barns and facilities to discover collectible cars which include the likes of the Morris Minor Traveller, Jaguar XJS, Rover P6 and a BMW 635 CSI among many others. The combination of Drew's expertise of negotiation and deal-making and Paul's extensive mechanical knowledge makes them a formidable team ready to tackle anything challenging that comes their way.

programme.title: How It's Made
programme.desc: Have you ever wondered how things that surround us every day are produced? Find out about the whole process from the beginning to the end in a documentary television series How It's Made. The series demonstrates how various items like clothing and accessories, food, industrial products, cars, musical instruments and many more are manufactured. Who would have thought how exciting it would be to watch a cupcake, formula 1 race car or gummy vitamins being made?

programme.title: How Do They Do It?
programme.desc: How Do They Do It? Ever wondered how the stripes get into toothpaste or how contact lenses are made? How do goods get from one country to another and then into our supermarkets? What are car tires made from and exactly why are plasma TV screens flat? Eating, drinking, driving, flying. These all are activities that we carry out with barely a second thought. But have you ever wondered what exactly goes into your teabag and how it got there? How does an airport handle hundreds of thousands of items of luggage each day? And just how can a car's airbag inflate so quickly? Every day – often without even realizing it – we come into contact with technology, be it in the bathroom, in the car or on the golf course. We take a look at how things work, and focus on some of the most amazing examples of everyday objects including the world's fastest elevator and the most expensive chocolate money can buy.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters: The Restorers
programme.desc: Expert craftsmen are bringing Drew Pritchard's finds back to life and restore them to their former glory. Drew hunts for treasures such as derelict gems and forgotten remnants across the country. And then he and his team do the restoration turning trash to gold, so that worn objects become shining gems for which Drew's customers want to pay a lot of money. All kinds of items can and will be restored, starting from a century-old suitcase to an ancient coffee machine, from a ravaged carousel horse to a large railway clock.

programme.title: Scrappers
programme.desc: Trading scrap metal is like playing the stock market. From a small collection point, scrap metal goes a long way to collect and segregate before it reaches the furnace. The steel mills order batches of appropriately selected and prepared raw materials in a specified quantity and time. To trade scrap metal, you must have the ability to do business as well as luck. This program invites you to meet people who work in scrap yards all over Poland.

programme.title: Farmhouse Fixer
programme.desc: The nostalgia, charm and history behind New England farmhouses are a few of the reasons Jonathan Knight loves to restore old homes. With the help of his designer, Kristina, Jonathan works to keep that history alive by breathing new life into the homes.

programme.title: Homestead Rescue

programme.title: Diesel Brothers
programme.desc: Unique American reality series that follows a group of friends in Utah- David ''Heavy D'' Sparks, David ''Diesel Dave'' Kiley, and their crew at ''DieselSellerz'' who sell parts for diesel trucks and jeeps, repair and customize pickup trucks. They design and build some of the biggest and most amazing diesel powered vehicles you will ever see, and also do truck giveaways. Watch as they create these awesome masterpieces and enjoy all the crazy adventures they get into while doing it.

programme.title: Garage Rehab
programme.desc: American petrol head and reality TV star, Richard Rawlings, famous for his show Fast N' Loud, visits struggling garages and car workshops that are desperate for a helping hand. Alongside the team of world-class mechanics from his Gas Monkey Garage, Richard invests his precious time and money to get these toiling businesses back where they belong. The team visit workshops all over the USA, using their knowledge and experience to rev up the old girls and get their engines purring once more. With a serious amount of elbow grease on top of the help from Richard's team, the owners have a shot once more at a successful business.

programme.title: Border Control Sweden
programme.desc: The security and customs services at the border of Sweden are on constant watch to stop illegal items entering the country. It's their job to detect crime.

programme.title: Border Control: Spain
programme.desc: The documentary series accompanies the border guards of Spain in their daily fight against crime - on land, at sea and in the air. Around the clock, the men and women are on duty to pre-empt drug traffickers, smugglers and smugglers. The role of the security forces is manifold: from the fight against hashish transport in the strait of Gibraltar to the smashing of organized human trafficking at the airport in Madrid to the search for counterfeit branded goods in the port of Barcelona.

programme.title: Salvage Hunters
programme.desc: Drew Pritchard is a modern-day treasure hunter searching the back roads of the UK to discover hidden riches. With demanding customers, high turnover and one of the biggest decorative salvage yards in the UK, Drew is constantly on the road, crisscrossing the country in search of derelict gems and forgotten remnants. Drew loves the thrill of the hunt and while he gets his hands dirty in the country's architectural backwaters, his crack team of restorers is back at the shop giving old and rare finds a new lease on life. Follow Drew and his crack team of specialists on a fascinating journey through the entire picking process – from the initial expedition, to renewal, and finally to resale. Showcasing his hard-earned knowledge and appreciation of salvage and restoration, each episode accompanies Drew on one big buying venture, such as setting off with an empty van and returning with a 20th century stained glass Gothic doorway from an Irish monastery – as well as the small, unpredictable adventures along the way. Simply discovering a treasure is only half the battle, as Drew must artfully convince owners to sell, and at his price. After a successful purchase, Drew and his team of experts bring the items back to Fabulously British Salvage, his tremendous 20,000 square foot showroom located in North Wales, to restore them to their original brilliance, before reselling them for profit. This is not an easy business, as any trip can feature the next great find or a bust that costs Drew and his team thousands. However, Drew's keen eye and adroit negotiating skills are second to none – his passion and drive for success make him one of the best in the business.

programme.title: Finding Escobar's Millions
programme.desc: At one time Pablo Escobar — the most wanted man on the planet — buried masses of his estimated multi-billion-dollar fortune all over Colombia. Legends say the vast majority of it has never been found. With never-before-granted access and permission in Colombia, two former intelligence officers armed with the skills and training from 10 years of work in the CIA go on the hunt for the alleged hidden treasure in Finding Escobar's Millions.

programme.title: Love & Translation
programme.desc: The series brings three American men and 12 international women together on a remote paradise island for a chance at finding romance. And here's the twist: none of the women speak English and none of the men speak other languages. Without being able to speak to one another and without the use of translators, the singles need to count on their senses to help develop their connection and determine the power of their chemistry and attraction.

programme.title: 7 Little Johnstons
programme.desc: Amber and Trent Johnston are living the American dream. They have been happily married for 14 years and have five children ranging from 6 to 13 years old. On paper, they might seem like your average family...yet in person, they attract a lot of attention.... because all seven members of the Johnston family – Amber, Trent, their two biological children, Jonah and Elizabeth, as well as their three adopted children, Anna, Emma and Alex – happen to have Achondroplasia Dwarfism. Together, these spunky seven make up the largest known family of Achondroplastic dwarfs in the world, and even describe themselves as "the real life seven dwarfs."

programme.title: Sweet Home Sextuplets
programme.desc: Courtney and Eric Waldrop, their three older boys and sextuplet babies are a tight-knit family living on a sheep farm in small town Alabama. Their strong desire for one more baby resulted in the biggest possible surprise- sextuplets. Have a close look at this adorable family and all of its members starting from the days when there were "just" five of them. Risky pregnancy, premature birth, arriving home, taking care of six babies, managing the whole family and adjusting to the new pace of life- all of this and much more are there for the viewers.

programme.title: Say Yes to the Dress America
programme.desc: Looking for your perfect dress? Kleinfeld Bridal is the place for you. Follow brides as they head off on their search for the perfect wedding dress, no matter how big or small in the city of New York. Bringing their friends and family along to help them decide, will they girls trip to the store be an easy one? The brides are each assisted by a consultant during a private shopping event, the outcome being that all important dress.

programme.title: Kitchen Boss
programme.desc: Hosted by Buddy Valastro, this cooking program takes various Italian-American dishes from Valastro's own family recipes and shows how they can be prepared in minimal time and using ingredients that are easily obtainable and affordable. Each meal usually consists of a main course, a side dish and a dessert and Buddy is joined in the kitchen by members of his family to show us how it's done and to add authenticity. Episodes feature Buddy and his wife Lisa making chicken Sorrentino with fusilli with a side of asparagus and chocolate dipped strawberries for dessert for date night; Auntie Anna revealing her secret recipes for manicotti and her chicken with vinegar peppers; or Buddy and his cousin Frankie reminiscing about the sights and food of Italian street fairs. The recipe for each dish can be found on the show's website.

programme.title: 90 Day Fiance
programme.desc: Buckle up, TLC and 90 Day Fiancé fans! Hot off their upcoming appearance on 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER?, fan-favorites Pedro and Chantel and their lively in-laws will be the focal point of a spinoff series from the 90 DAY FIANCÉ franchise called THE FAMILY CHANTEL, premiering Monday nights this July. Ever since Chantel first introduced Pedro to her family under the false pretense of him coming to America on a student visa, the drama that followed has kept fans obsessed. From their beginnings on 90 DAY FIANCÉ season four through 90 DAY FIANCÉ: HAPPILY EVER AFTER, Pedro and Chantel have weathered major marital ups and downs involving everything from feisty family members to their own trust issues. Viewers will follow this unique modern family as they try to move past their differences and come together as an extended family, but as Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas try to protect their brood, will they push their children too far? The family members featured in the upcoming series include Chantel's parents Karen and Thomas and siblings River and Winter, as well as Pedro's mother Lidia and sister Nicole.

programme.title: The Bad Skin Clinic
programme.desc: British docuseries following the work of leading dermatologist, Dr Emma Craythorne as she explores extreme skin conditions. Join her team at their Harley Street clinic in London, as she meets patients who have been seriously affected by a range of often debilitating conditions. From severe acne and rosacea to deep painful cysts, follow the stories of the patients from diagnosis through to recovery as they undergo dramatic cosmetic procedures. For the patients who had once struggled to leave their home, will their treatment under knives, needles and lasers help change their skin and lives for good?

programme.title: Too Large
programme.desc: With the help of bariatric surgeon Dr. Procter, morbidly obese individuals attempt to lose weight in order to change their lives forever; they face challenges as they work to reinvent their lifestyles.

programme.title: 1000-lb Sisters
programme.desc: With an average weight of over 1000lbs, nothing can support the Slaton sisters like they can support each other. With hopes of a healthier life, the sisters embark on a journey to drop enough weight that they qualify for a life changing bariatric surgery. Without the surgery, Amy will never be able to become a mother like she dreams of, and Tammy will be bedridden. After meeting with medical experts, the sisters strive to reach their goal but drama ensues as they struggle to stick to their healthy diets. Will the Slaton sisters stay on the right track and turn their lifestyles around?

programme.title: Dr. Pimple Popper
programme.desc: Definitely not created for the squeamish, Dr Pimple Popper features dermatologist and Internet celebrity Dr. Sandra Lee as she treats patients suffering with unique skin conditions such as facial and skin disorders. Including the extraction of blackheads, cysts and uncovering new skin conditions that audiences may not have known of before, Dr. Sandra Lee started uploading content onto Youtube and Instagram, gaining a lot of popularity by people enjoying spots and cysts being popped. Those included within her videos gave written permission for her to record and post the content in exchange for discounted or free-treatments. Dr. Pimple Popper is on a mission to reclaim the lives of those suffering with these unusual and rare skin condition and remove their embarrassment.

programme.title: Body Bizarre
programme.desc: Criss-crossing the globe, 'Body Bizarre' embarks on a voyage of discovery unlike any other. From India's child snake charmers to the world's hairiest girl, this series uncovers the real human stories behind the headlines. With deeply personal interviews and footage from the most unusual of day-to-day routines, it's an adventure through the truly astonishing. Six-year-old Liu Jiangli was abandoned by her parents as a two-year-old after being born with large black spots and fur on her face and body. Connie Culp became the first American to undergo a face transplant in 2008, after being shot in the face by her ex-husband. These stories, and others, explore what life is like for some of the world's most extraordinary individuals.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. This season on Air Crash Investigation: Conflicting stories emerge after a Swedish cargo plane spirals to the ground; an African airliner crashes in the wilderness and the cause proves too sinister to be believed; and, when a Pakistani passenger jet disappears on approach to Kathmandu, Nepalese investigators must determine how it ended up on a crash course with the Himalayas.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: January 15th, 2009 - Less than two minutes after taking off from New York's LaGuardia Airport, US Airways Flight #1549 collides with a flock of birds. Both engines suddenly lose all thrust, and the Airbus A-320 begins falling from the sky. The crew desperately tries to restart their engines, but can't. With New York on one side and New Jersey on the other, Captain Chesley Sullenberger is running out of options. Searching desperately for a place to land, Sullenberger warns passengers and crew to brace for impact and tells the control tower that he will be ditching the plane in the icy waters of the Hudson River. Amazingly, all 155 people on board survive, and investigators try to determine how birds could have crippled two of the world's most advanced jet engines. Can they prevent it from happening again?

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Harrowing stories of tragedy and triumph are brought to life through official reports, transcripts and interviews with the pilots, air traffic controllers and lucky survivors of history's most terrifying crashes. Widely considered to be the safest form of travel, air transportation is still in its infancy and when midair calamity strikes, the results are often catastrophic. From the cockpit to the cabin, from the control room to the crash scene, we uncover just what went wrong.

programme.title: Science of Stupid
programme.desc: Science of Stupid, series 8. Dallas Campbell hosts the show that combines serious science with some of the craziest, most spectacular user generated clips ever recorded. In each programme we show 40 to 50 clips of misadventure: ordinary folk making extraordinary mistakes and paying the price. We analyse the science behind the mishaps, with the help of bespoke animation and super slow-motion cinematography.

programme.title: Megafactories
programme.desc: Ultimate Factories also known as Megafactories is an American documentary television series that premiered in 2006 on the National Geographic Channel. The program explores the inner workings of factories worldwide. Each episode profiles the machinery and manpower behind each factory's main product, featuring close-ups, breakdowns, interviews, and side stories to show the sequence of events to produce the product in the factory. Hoff Productions was one of the principal producers of this highly successful series. It also airs in non-US markets as Megafactories.

programme.title: Megafactories
programme.desc: For 20 years, Lexus has been synonymous with quiet, efficient, luxury. Now they have launched their first supercar - the Lexus LFA. Going from 0 to 100kph in under four seconds, it's anything but understated. This is the construction story behind the Japanese supercar. Hand built at the LFA Works in Toyota City, Japan, this car's body is 65% carbon fibre and powered by one of the highest revving production engine on the road. At $375,000 it's also one of the most luxuriously priced Japanese road cars ever.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Exciting documentary series that shows viewers some extreme and extraordinary construction projects- the biggest, tallest, longest or deepest in the world, and the machines that are used to create such amazing structures. The series features interviews with designers and project managers, who present the problems of construction and the methodology or techniques used to overcome obstacles. Some ''megastructures'' included in the series are US Navy's aircraft carrier, the USS Ronald Reagan, highway with no speed limit built in Germany, undersea tunnel built between France and United Kingdom, world's longest suspension bridge in Japan, twin tower skyscraper in Kuala Lumpur, etc.

programme.title: Megastructures
programme.desc: Megastructures: Sagrada Familia is an inside look at one of the most clever and inspiring structures in Europe. The long life of its construction allows to show from traditional architectural construction techniques to the use of recent science and technology breakthroughs, including architectural 3D visualization. Sagrada Familia represents the harmony between the old and the new, between the constructors of medieval cathedrals and geniuses of postmodernism.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Mysterious structures on an abandoned Italian island reveal a dark past. An exploration of Japan's Battleship Island reveals a troubled history. Strange trees on the Yemeni island of Socotra are examined. On Indonesia's Flores Island, an unusual skull is found in a cave.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: Findings include a small volcanic island off coast of Edinburgh with a dark past; elaborate ancient Egyptian style burials on Sudan's Sai Island. A bronze device recovered from a long, lost shipwreck is actually an ancient analog computer. Scientists investigating the sudden disappearance of sharks around Californian islands reveal the interesting connection between orcas and great white sharks.

programme.title: Mysterious Islands
programme.desc: An abandoned Cold War-era Russian military base is explored, and a palatial mansion is found decaying on Isla Grande off the Colombian coast. In the waters off of Japan's Yonaguni Island, a stone structure is discovered on the seafloor. Evidence of a turbulent past is unearthed on Italy's volcanic Stromboli Island.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: Even during a pandemic, smuggling never stops. After adjusting tactics in the early days of the COVID crisis to meet the increasing flow of narcotics coming across our southern land borders, the Department of Homeland Security is now pivoting back to our nation's airports where international travel is starting to rev back up again. Whether narco-traffickers try to slip through an airport, seaport or land crossing, vigilant officers are on high-alert to stem the flow of illegal contraband. Using every tool available to them, DHS will stop at nothing to catch a smuggler.

programme.title: To Catch a Smuggler
programme.desc: The U.S. Coast Guard stops smugglers with over 13,000 kilos of cocaine at sea and transfers custody to Homeland Security Investigations for prosecution. At Dulles International Airport, near the nation's capital, U.S. Customs and Border Protection officers uncover weapons heading outbound during checks for unreported currency. In El Paso, CBP Agricultural Specialists inspect live and deceased animals to protect the U.S. from foreign diseases, like avian flu.

programme.title: Air Crash Investigation
programme.desc: Every time a plane crashes, the world takes notice. And so do the experts whose job it is to figure out what happened. Air Crash Investigation uncovers the truth behind the most legendary aviation disasters, and every episode features eyewitness accounts, captivating reenactments, state-of-the-art CGI, and interviews with the investigators who ultimately determined what went wrong. Unraveling the complex mystery is a painstaking process that takes months—and sometimes years—of detective work. The twisted wreckage at the crash site tells part of the story; investigators can use it to learn about the final seconds of a flight and rule out mechanical failures. The flight data and cockpit voice recorders are critical, but they don't always reveal what happened. It almost always takes a tragic combination of factors to bring down an airplane.

programme.desc: After circling above the Taiwan Strait to wait out a passing cyclone, TransAsia Flight 222 crashes on the Taiwanese resort island of Penghu. programme.desc: Gumbot: Gumby has been horribly abducted! A red helicopter snatches Gumby up and takes him to an evil robotics company, where the Blockheads brainwash him by making him look at flashing lights. Fortunately, Pokey saw the helicopter take Gumby, and even more fortunately, the Blockheads leave it parked on top of the building where they're keeping Gumby. The Blockheads are vaguely defeated, and Goo undoes Gumby's brainwashing by crying all over him. I guess the other clay figures are still working for the evil robotics company. After smashing up a guitar store a book about 17th century Spanish guitars, he's forced to accept a magical guitar that makes you fly around. It'll be a nice act for his next concert, once he's had it repaired. One of the Blockheads impersonates the repairman, and of course, Goo doesn't recognize him, what with how he's wearing a fake mustache and all, so she gives him the guitar. When she realizes she's been duped, Gumby and friends chase the Blockheads into a field, where they get caught in a hay thresher/baler. We end with Gumby's concert, where Gumby flies away with the guitar and is ultimately stuck on some sort of spinning blade thingy. Gumbitty Doo Dah: There's no real "story" in this one. programme.title: No Man Left Behind
programme.desc: October 1993. Keni Thomas and Randy Ramaglia are among a squad of US Rangers and Delta Force who rope down from Black Hawk helicopters into the capital of war-ravaged Somalia. Their mission: to capture two top lieutenants of rebel leader Mohamed Aidid. But the daring raid goes disastrously wrong when Black Hawk Super 6-1 is shot down over the city. The ground troops are sent to secure the crash sites but they are outgunned and overrun, sustaining multiple casualties. When Super 6-4 pilot Mike Durant flies in to help, his Black hawk is shot down too. His crew dead, he is captured and held for 11 days. The infamous Battle of Mogadishu sees 18 Americans dead and 73 injured.

Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G3. AS Monaco - Olympiacos
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: Godzilla vs. Kong
programme.desc: Filmis lähevad müütilised legendid vastamisi aegade suurimas lahingus, kui kaalul on maailma saatus. Kong ja ta kaitsjad võtavad ette ohtliku teekonna, et leida ta tõeline kodu. Nende seas on ka noor orvust tüdruk Jia, kellega Kongil tekkis ainulaadne ja tugev side. Kuid ootamatult satuvad nad kõikjal maailmas hävingut põhjustava raevunud Godzilla teele. programme.title: Punane sekund
programme.desc: Eestis on rohkelt jalgrattamatkajaid, kes pidevalt sõitmas käivad. Turvalisem oleks sõita kergliiklusteel, kuid igal pool seda võimalust ei ole. Uurime, kuidas maanteel ohutult sõita. Traagiline õnnetus 9-aastase jalgratturiga tuletab meelde, et laste käitumine on tihti ettearvamatu ja autojuhid peavad seda teadvustama. Lapsed peavad aga kindlasti läbima jalgratturi koolituse. programme.title: Korvpall: EuroLeague. Playoffs G3. Hapoel TA - Real Madrid
programme.desc: The EuroLeague is the top-tier European professional basketball club competition since 2000. The competition replaced the FIBA EuroLeague (which was previously called the FIBA European Champions Cup, or simply the European Cup), which had been run by FIBA since 1958. Starting from 2010/2011 season the tournament is named Turkish Airlines Euroleague, due to a sponsorship contract of Turkish Airlines with EuroLeague, and in 2013 the contract was prolonged to 2020. The tournament is aired in 199 countries of the world. The current EuroLeague structure is made up of 16 teams, which each play each other twice, once at home and once away, in a double round robin league regular season, each team plays 30 games. The top 8 placed teams at the end of the regular season advance to playoffs, each plays a 5 game playoff series against a single opponent. The winners of each playoff series advance to the Final Four held in a predetermined city for two days. The Final Four features two semifinals, a third place game, and the championship game, all on the same weekend.

programme.title: TV3 uudised

Kui igatsed uudistesaadet, mis on aktuaalne, täpne, pisut terav, südamlik ning kus saab ka grammikese nalja, siis õige valik on "TV3 uudised". "TV3 uudised" on eetris igal õhtul kell 19.00. programme.title: Kodu keset linna

Argipäeviti mahub tunniajasesse saatesse põhjalik ülevaade nii Eestist kui välismaalt. Räägime näiliselt keerulistest asjadest selgelt ja arusaadavalt - sest aega on. Kange iseloomuga Doktor Silva ei kohku aga tagasi ja hakkab tegelema kohaliku rahva eriskummaliste haigusjuhtumitega, üritab külarahva umbusuga võidelda ja kõigele lisaks varjab ta oma hingesopis hämarat saladust, mis oli tema pealinnast pagemise põhjuseks.

Sarja trumbiks on haaravad ja inimlikult usutavad tegelaskujud, kelle eludega on vaatajal kerge samastuda. Tegelaste galerii on ka piisavalt mitmekesine, et igaüks leiaks endale lemmiku, kellele kaasa elada - siin on nii teismelisi, noori täiskasvanuid kui ka juba küpsesse keskikka jõudnud peategelasi. Lisaboonuseks on Summer Bay igikestev päikesepaiste, mis rõhutab sarja positiivsust ja elurõõmu.

programme.title: Miss Marple

programme.title: Murdochi müsteeriumid
programme.desc: Murdoch ja Ogden peavad tribunalil Terrence Meyersi vastu tunnistusi andma. Endist valitsusagenti süüdistatakse plaanis mürgitada Kanada peaministrit võikoogiga.

Kohtumine talle öömaja pakkunud piiskopiga muudab tema elu igaveseks. Samal ajal tutvub Pariisi õmblejanna Fantine jõuka ja lõbuhimulise noormehega.

programme.title: Miss Marple

Iga kord teenivad lapsed auhinnaks mõne uue märgi.

programme.desc: Sisene lihtsasse Anna ja sõprade maailma, milles on rõõmu ja entusiasmi, mida lapsepõlv toob. Sarjas "Anna ja sõbrad" on viis lahutamatut sõpra, kes tähistavad sõpruse võimet, kujutlusvõimelist mängu ja tagaaia seikluseid!

programme.title: Pisid

programme.title: Püramiidi tipus
programme.desc: Kristy Kultas-Ilinsky on Tallinnas Vabaduse väljakul asunud kuulsa Kultase kohviku omaniku Nikolai Kultase tütar. Tema elu on olnud täis suuri pöördeid: juba väikese lapsena küüditati ta koos vanematega Siberisse, teaduskraadi sai ta Moskva ülikoolist ja teadustööd teeb ta koos abikaasa Igor Ilinskyga juba aastakümneid Ameerika Ühendriikides. Nad uurivad aju piirkondi, mis juhivad keha motoorikat. Eriti huvitavad Kristyt Parkinsoni tõve tekkepõhjused ja ravivõimalused. Praegu on Ilinskyd ametis uue aju atlase ettevalmistamisega. Kuigi Kristy Kultas on oma elu jooksul elanud Eestis vaid kaheksa aastat, ütleb ta saates selges eesti keeles, et peab end alati eestlaseks ja Eesti teadlaseks. Saate autor Neeme Raud, režissöör Tarvo Mölder, operaator Tauno Sirel, produtsent Ene-Maris Tali.

programme.title: Tähelaev
programme.desc: "Tähelaeva" külaline on muusikaorbiidil tiirelnud ajast, mil Eestis rokkisid sellised suured staarid nagu Anne Veski, Jaak Joala jt. Oma sõnul on ta "lootusetult armunud muusikasse. Esimese Eestist pärit Eurovisiooni võidulaulu autori Ivar Mustaga ajab juttu Heidy Purga. Režissöör Kalev Lepik. Täna on Ivar Mustal 60. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!

programme.title: Impulss

programme.title: Salaopakad
programme.desc: Kas salapärane Kirsty, Clintoni telefonist leitud arvatav kontaktisik, võib just olla inimene, kes Domi ja Kay sellest jamast välja aitab? Nad lepivad Kirstyga kohtumise kokku ja asuvad uurima kahtlaselt käituvat prefekt Edwardsit, tungides tema kabinetti.

programme.title: Esimene stuudio
programme.desc: Brüsseli koridorides murtakse pead, kuidas lappida USA ja Euroopa jahedamaks muutuvaid suhteid? Kas Washington on meiega ühes paadis? Mis saab kummalist rada kulgevast Ukraina rahuprotsessist? Kas Euroopa nüüd tõepoolest hakkab relvastuma? Euroopa Parlamendi telestuudios väitlevad Urmas Paet, Marina Kaljurand, Sven Mikser, Riho Terras, Jüri Ratas, Jaak Madison ja Jaana Toom. Saatejuht Andres Kuusk, režissöör Rait Roland Veskemaa, produtsent Tiina-Mari Koljak.

programme.title: Alexander Armstrong Sri Lankal
programme.desc: Sarja viimases osas sõidab Alexander Armstrong 30 aastat kodusõja käes kannatanud Sri Lanka põhjaossa, kus püütakse miinidest puhastada sadu hektareid maid. Ta külastab ka vastuolulist, aga Indias ja Sri Lankal siiani populaarset pullide võiduajamist. Tagasi saare kaguossa jõudnult uurib Alexander lähemalt saare muistset ajalugu ja kolme tuhande aasta vanust võitluskunsti, mida britid proovisid tulutult ära keelata.

programme.title: Mina ka

programme.title: Operatsioon Ai
programme.desc: Tule avasta põnevaid teadmisi inimkehast. Sarja juhivad kaksikud dr Chris ja dr Xand van Tulleken, kes teevad teaduslikke katseid ja uurivad meditsiini ning bioloogia huvitavat maailma. Saa üle hirmust haigla ees ja vaata oma silmaga, mida põnevat seal tegelikult tehakse ning millised uskumatud protsessid meie kehas toimuvad. Suurbritannia linnades filmitud sarjas näeme päris patsiente kriisiolukorras ja meie arstid Chris ning Xand näitavad, kui põnevalt toimib kiirabi ja milleks on meie keha suuteline äärmuslikes olukordades.

programme.desc: Peakorteris selgub, et agentide torusüsteemi kaart on sattunud kurikaelte kätte, kes korraldavad kivi-paber-käärid võistluse, mille võitja saab kaardi endale. Agent Olive'ile antakse eriülesanne imbuda kurikaelte hulka, et kaart kätte saada. Kas tal õnnestub Oscari ja Otto abiga ennustada, kes mis märke kasutab?

programme.title: Kosmo
programme.desc: Koer Kosmo on Williamsite pere suur karvane lemmikloom. Tema ja 13-aastane Robi on südamesõbrad, ent ühel päeval juhtub õnnetus - Kosmo jääb auto alla ning saab tõsiselt vigastada. Robil ja tema parimal sõbral, nutikal ratastoolitüdrukul Elisel õnnestub robootikafirmas, kus töötab Robi ema, asendada Kosmo vigastatud organid bioonilistega, ja sel viisil koera elu päästa. Bioonilised kehaosad annavad Kosmole supervõimed, tänu neile võimetele aitab Kosmo Robil ja Elisel lahendada kõiksugu põnevaid saladusi ning tuua päevavalgele kurikaelte salasepitsusi Merisilma linnakeses, kus nad kõik elavad. Sündmustele lisab põnevust asjaolu, et lapsed peavad kiivalt varjama oma koera saladust, sest selle ilmsikstulek võib maksta Robi emale töökoha. Ema Ester on aga ainuke, kes perele leiva lauale toob.

programme.desc: Yazid on asenduskodudes üles kasvanud poiss, kellel on lapsest saadik suur kirg kondiitritoodete valmistamise vastu. See on ainus, mis teda tõeliselt rõõmustab ja ta otsustab saada ise parimatest parimaks! Kõige selle saavutamiseks tuleb taluda magamata öid, kuhjades nõude pesemist, peakoka viha, kriitikute nõuandeid ja palju muid kannatusi. Tal on ees aga kindel siht - võita maailma parima dessert-koka tiitel ja saada oma restoranile kolm tärni. Inspireeriv linalugu põhineb kuulsa prantsuse kondiitri Yazid Ichemrahen'i reaalsel elul ja edulool. R: Sébastien Tulard. O: Riadh Belaïche, Loubna Abidar, Marwan Amesker jt.

"Plekktrummi" külaline on lavakunstikooli XXXI lennu juhendaja, näitleja ja lavastaja Jaak Prints. Saatejuht Joonas Hellerma, toimetaja Hedi Rosma, režissöör Maire Radsin, produtsent Laura-Liisa Veiler. Täna on Jaak Printsil 45. sünnipäev. Palju õnne!
