programme.title: Ждём в гости
programme.desc: Проект Ирины Хангошвили о культуре, истории и традициях различных стран мира. Ведущий - Зураб Двали - путешествует и приглашает зрителей пройтись вместе с ним по красивым местам, увидеть достопримечательности, полюбоваться природой и познакомиться с интересными людьми. Всюду гостеприимные хозяева говорят нашим телезрителям: "Ждем в гости!" Зрители сначала узнают интересные исторические факты о самых известных или забытых регионах различных стран, и затем останавливаются на кулинарных традициях - готовят несколько блюд с гостями программы.

programme.title: Встречная полоса
programme.desc: Автомобильная авария переворачивает жизнь Крапивиных навсегда. Игорь попадает в больницу с сильной травмой головы, а его жене Любе открывается шокирующая правда. Оказывается, ее любимый муж ей изменяет. Об этом Люба узнает из сообщений, которые приходят на телефон Игоря от его молодой любовницы Ники. Люба оказывается перед серьезным выбором — открыть ли правду об измене мужа семье? Нужно ли признаться любовнице мужа, что Люба в курсе их отношений? И, наконец, как поступить — бороться за жизнь Игоря или бросить его?

programme.title: Госпожа Фазилет и ее дочери
programme.desc: Госпожа Фазилет после того, как потеряла мужа, одна воспитывает двух дочек. Вся жизнь Фазилет прошла в сожалениях, поэтому теперь ее вкладом в будущее стала младшая дочь Эдже. Но самым большим препятствием на пути матери является старшая дочь Хазан, которая несмотря на свою изысканную красоту ведет себя по-мальчишески и не ладит с матерью. Семья Эймен богата, могущественна, у них особняк на берегу Босфора, и однажды их пути пересекаются с Фазилет и ее дочерьми. Богатство Эймен даже превосходит мечты Фазилет. После знакомства с ними изменится не только жизнь Эдже, но и Хазан, которая влюбится в Синана Эймена, избалованного сына семьи.

programme.title: Провинциальный детектив
programme.desc: После событий первого сезона прошёл год, за который многое изменилось. Татьяна переехала в новый дом, и теперь не заскочишь утром на чашку кофе обсудить последние новости. Но никакие расстояния не могут разлучить подруг, и когда Ольгу обвиняют в убийстве соседки Инны Малеевой, Татьяна бросается на помощь. Она вычислит настоящего убийцу - на этот раз ключ к разгадке найдется у отца Брауна, героя детективных романов Честертона.

programme.title: Главное
programme.desc: Ежедневная информационная программа Настоящего времени.

programme.title: Пять минут тишины. Возвращение
programme.desc: Александр Грек, вернувшись после стажировки в Москву и узнав, что его невеста Лина, с которой он собирался окончательно расстаться, беременна, принимает решение жениться на матери своего ребенка. Однако остаться в столице у него не получается: ему уготована служба в отдалённом районе, и он просит направить его назад, в Карелию. Лина решает ехать с ним и там играть свадьбу. Вернувшись в Карелию, Греку предстоит пережить объяснение с Таней, которую он любит, и с Гиреевым, который зол на молодого человека, заставившего страдать его дочь.

programme.title: Гений
programme.desc: Обаятельный и талантливый авантюрист Сергей Ненашев, в прошлом талантливый физик, а ныне — директор овощного магазина, вооружившись электроникой, не оставляет милиции никаких шансов для обвинения в криминале. И даже мафия, которую он ненароком "нагрел" на крупную сумму, попадает впросак, решив ему отомстить.

programme.title: Лицом к событию
programme.desc: Лидер в той или иной сфере общественной жизни - человек известный и информированный - под перекрестным огнем вопросов ведущих программы Михаила Соколова и Елены Рыковцевой.

programme.title: Голое влечение
programme.desc: Скандальный цикл передач, в которых люди находят потенциальных спутников жизни, обнаженные тела которых им показывают. Затем они должны будут сами раздеться и сделать выбор.

programme.title: Хор
programme.desc: 1972 год. Однажды услышав песни Робертино Лоретти, 12-летний школьник из Люберец Юра тоже начинает петь. Сначала он стесняется этого, ведь пение, по мнению его сверстников и некоторых взрослых, — совсем не мужское занятие. Но, благодаря наставничеству молодой учительницы музыки Варвары, Юра развивает свой талант и решается пройти прослушивание в хор Грачева. У руководителя хора есть всего месяц, чтобы расширить состав исполнителей и подготовить новую программу для участия в телефестивале "Песня года".

programme.title: Erin Burnett OutFront
programme.desc: Hosted by Erin Burnett, an expert in political science and economics, OutFront is an hour-long news programme examining the latest stories from the US and further afield. Broadcast live from either the New York studio or live on location from the site of a breaking story, the show features insightful opinions from informed guests. With expert analysis from CNN's correspondents and analysis from the show's panel, Erin Burnett OutFront dissects the stories of the day, leaving no stone unturned. Burnett, a former financial analyst for Goldman Sachs, uses her forthright approach to engage interviewees in honest discussion.

The show has won an absolute plethora of awards over the years, including GLAAD Media and Emmy awards.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons are a totally normal family. Dad is your regular 6"4 pink rabbit who stays at home while Mom works in a rainbow factory. Their kids are pretty standard too - there's Gumball, a blue cat with a giant head, Anais, a 4 year old genius bunny, and Darwin, a pet goldfish that became part of the family when he sprouted legs. At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: Mom has forced Dad to install a password on the computer. The pop-up clue advises them that the password is the name of Dad's favorite child. After trying "Gumball" and "Darwin" unsuccessfully, they discover the answer is, in fact, "Anais". They are determined to become Dad's favourites by any means necessary, even if it means undermining each other, plotting against Anais or driving a wedge between mom and dad.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Wattersons discover a family of cartoon copycats who mimic their every move. / Grandpa Louie has a new online friend - the only problem is she isn't real. / The kids find out that Richard has been being picked on by the same person since high school. / Gumball and Darwin decide to use online reviews to wrangle free stuff. / A mysterious package shows up at the Watterson's house and they do their best to avoid opening it. / Darwin likes a girl in his class so Gumball decides it's time to play cupid. / Gumball's smart answers aren't the correct ones and he's forced to go back to kindergarten. / Gumball and Darwin discover the real reason Dad's diet wasn't working. / Gumball discovers that Rob his old nemesis is neme-seeing someone else now.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: Robin, Starfire, Cyborg, Beast Boy and Raven continue the fun in season seven of TEEN TITANS GO! with all-new comedic adventures, giving viewers a look at what life is really like as a teen super hero ... once the cape comes off. Inspired by and featuring the principal voice cast of the original Teen Titans series, this character-driven comedy - based upon DC characters - focuses on the funny that happens in between saving the world and living together as teenagers without adult supervision. With epic staring contests to decide who does the laundry, a series of quests and battles to construct the perfect sandwich or fighting crime in Jump City, one thing is for sure - these Titans are always ready for an adventure, inside the house and out.

programme.title: Teen Titans Go!
programme.desc: After breaking his leg, Robin is confined to his room and spies through a telescope. / Control Freak thinks the Titans' humor is too juvenile for their time-slot, so he ages them down to a preschool show. / In order to find out about his family history, Robin takes a DNA test and discovers he's from Babylon. / Raven explains astrology to the Titans and tells their horoscopes, but Cyborg does not believe.

programme.title: Craig of the Creek
programme.desc: Craig and his two best friends, Kelsey and JP, are always going on adventures in the untamed suburban wilderness known as the Creek - a kid utopia where tribes of children rule over tree forts and bike ramps, making up an entire kid society. Each episode finds the kids either venturing into unexplored areas of the Creek, encountering new Creek Kids, or just getting into trouble at their hang out - the Stump.

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball

programme.title: The Amazing World of Gumball
programme.desc: The Amazing World of Gumball revolves around the life of Gumball Watterson, a 12-year-old cat who attends middle school in the fictional city of Elmore. Accompanied by his adoptive goldfish brother and best friend Darwin, he frequently finds himself involved in various shenanigans around the city, during which he interacts with his other family members - sister Anais and parents Nicole and Richard - and an extended supporting cast of characters. With relatable themes and a unique cast of characters, The Amazing World of Gumball exemplifies the funny, amazing, sweet and optimistic side of kids' everyday life. Injected with a good deal of humor and unpredictable nonsense, Gumball's world reflects the modern family and everyday issues that kids understand.

programme.title: Regular Show
programme.desc: Mordecai the blue jay and Rigby the raccoon hate having to do work as groundskeepers at the local park, trying to slack off whenever they can. When they have simple problems to solve, they often lead to a surreal, extreme, and often supernatural misadventures. Usually this makes their boss, Benson (a gumball machine) extremely angry and on the verge to fire them and annoys their coworker, Skips (a yeti, voiced by Mark Hamill). The pair are always saved by the other manager/owner Pops (a man with a lollipop-shaped head) as he enjoys their constant antics. Co-workers Muscle-Man (an overweight, green man) and Hi-Five Ghost sometimes get involved in the shenanigans, but usually find a way out and leave Mordecai and Rigby in the firing line.

At the heart of the show is Gumball, who faces the trials and tribulations of any twelve-year-old kid - like being chased by a rampaging T-Rex, sleeping rough when a robot steals his identity, or dressing as a cheerleader and doing the splits to impress the girl of his dreams. Simple everyday issues we've all been through. Gumball's hometown of Elmore is every bit as commonplace… a cactus waters his front lawn, a furry slug drives to work, and on the corner a balloon, a potato and a ghost all wait for the school bus. Welcome to The Amazing World of Gumball, where normal just got a little bit weird…

programme.desc: Documentary series. The beautiful diversity of Sri Lanka is laid bare for all to see in this exquisite travel show. A country encompassing more than 21 million inhabitants, Sri Lanka is know for it's gorgeous climate, pristine beaches and rich culture. With a focus on the country's history, the show explores the religious foundations of this ever-developing nation, and reveals just why it is so attractive to tourists. Nicknamed the "teardrop of India" this paradisaical island gem is home to some of our planet's most fascinating wildlife.

programme.title: Kissed by the Sea
programme.desc: Kissed by the Sea on Travelxp opens a wonderful sea world with its unbelievable bright colors. Staying by the sea side is one of the most romantic ideas for travelling. Experience a true paradise where the azul waves wash your feet. Relax just by listening to the waves whisper, uncover tropical beaches with endless sunshine and watch thousands of colorful fishes swimming around you in the salty sea water.

programme.title: Great World Hotels
programme.desc: Great World Hotels takes you on a journey to the some of the world's most luxurious hotels and resorts. We visit everything from your own personal lagoon island huts, the size of mansions, to the largest, most decadent penthouse in New York City. Live life like the stars as we explore every corner of the world from the comfort of your sofa. Season one alone takes us from Dubai to Mauritius to the Maldives. Whether you're an avid traveller or have never left the country, this journey is suitable for everyone. This is your journey. This is our journey.

programme.desc: Germany has the most attended football league in the world, in the Bundesliga. We bring these authentic fab experiences to your living room with all the key moments of the 2019-20 season, to ensure that your appetite for German football is well and truly met. The likes of Borussia Dortmund and Bayern Munich are met with stern competition this season, as RB Leipzig look to build on their third-placed finish from last season. programme.desc: PSG, AS Monaco, Marseille, Olympique Lyonnais & Lille... just to name a few. Ligue 1 is currently full of well-organised football teams and incredible European talent, who are a complement to the sport. As the highest professional division in France, it has established itself as one of the top five leagues on the continent. Lyon are the most successful team in regards to consecutive titles, whereas PSG and AS Monaco have managed to propel themselves to the highest achievements in the league, with calculated foreign investment. With the latter coming from a principality, Ligue 1 is another example of a domestic league that provides cross-border competition. From southern wine-growing regions such as Bordeaux, to the historically renowned capital of Paris, we cover the whole of France.

programme.desc: La Liga (The Campeonato Nacional de Liga de Primera División) is the men's top professional football division of the Spanish football league system. Nine teams have become champions, Real Madrid has got the title 33 times and FC Barcelona 26 times. La Liga is one of the most popular professional sports leagues in the world and the top league in Europe over the last five years.

programme.title: Mõrvaennetajad
programme.desc: Avahooajal USAs laineid löönud põnevussari salapärasest miljardärist, kes värbab endale appi endise CIA agendi, et ühiselt ennetada New Yorki ähvardavaid ränki kuritegusid. Pururikas geenius Finch ("Teadmata kadunud" staar Michael Emerson) on välja töötanud arvutiprogrammi, mis suudab tuvastada potentsiaalse mõrvari või tema ohvri veel enne selle kuriteo reaalset toimumist. programme.desc: USA 2004 Komöödia Lavastaja: Mark S. Waters Osades: Lindsay Lohan, Rachel McAdams, Lacey Chabert, Amanda Seyfried Cady Heron (Lindsay Lohan) on 15-aastane tüdruk, kes on terve elu koos zooloogidest vanematega Aafrika põõsaste all veetnud. Nüüd peab ta astuma aga tavalisse kooli ning kogeb omal nahal, et dzhungliseadused seal ei kehti. Tema teadmised ja arvamused olelusvõitlusest saavad hoopis uue tähenduse. Pikkus: 1 tund 37 minutit

programme.title: Kuu parim töötaja
programme.desc: Kastitassija Zack Bradley ja kassapidaja Vince Downey on kaks supermarketi rivaalitsevat töötajat. Vince on saanud peakassiiriks ning valiti 17 korda järjest kuu parimaks töötajaks. Zack on igavene lohe, aga oma kollegide hulgas hinnatud mees. Kui tööle saabub uus kassapidaja, silmipimestavalt kaunis ja seksikas Amy, muutub poes kõik. Zack ja Vince hakkavad võyitlema Amy tähelepanu nimel. Vince võlub naist oma kassapidamisoskuste ja auhindadega, Zack püüab võita Amy poolehoidu oma sarmi ja naljadega.

programme.title: Täitsa metsas!
programme.desc: Punamütsike, hunt, vanaema ja jahimees räägivad politseile nende kohtumise eellugu.

programme.title: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüksi film
programme.desc: USA 2004 animafilm Lavastaja: Stephen Hillenburg Bikiini Põhjas on taas muresid küllaga. Keegi on ära röövinud kuningas Neptuni krooni ja paistab, et süüdlaseks on Käsna-Kalle Kantpüksi ülemus hr Krabi. Kuigi Käsna-Kallelt on võetud võimalus saada oma unelmate töö, ei hülga ta oma bossi ja asub koos parima sõbra Patrickuga ohtuderohkele teekonnale Merekarbilinna, et saada tagasi kroon ja päästa hr Krabi elu. FILM ON EESTI KEELES!

programme.title: Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks
programme.desc: USA 2015 animafilm Lavastaja: Paul Tibbitt, Mike Mitchell Osades(hääled):Margus Tabor (Käsna-Kalle), Veikko Täär (Plankton), Andrus Vaarik (Kalmer), Mart Toome (Härra Krabi), Jarmo Reha (Patrick), Aita Vaher (Sandy), Liia Kanemägi-Jõerand (Karen), Tõnu Oja (Burksihabe), Juss Haasma (Kyle). Maailma kuulsaim mere-elanikust selgrootu, Käsna-Kalle Kantpüks, tuleb vee alt välja meie maailma seiklema. Härra Krabi ja Planktoni vahelise tüli käigus läheb kaduma salajane burgeri valmistamise retsept ning kui Bikini Põhja elanikud ei saa enam oma armastatud burksi süüa, võtab maad kohutav kaos. Kõik peavad retsepti varasteks Käsna-Kallet ja Planktonit. Kaasosalistest tandem ehitab olukorra päästmiseks ajamasina, millega siirdutakse aega enne retsepti salapärast kadumist. Teel satutakse aga kõikvõimalikesse teistesse kummalistesse paikadesse, kus kohatakse nii naljakaid kui ka nalja mitte mõistvaid olendeid. Kes on tegelikult burksiretsepti röövel ja mida kangelased Bikini Põhja rahu taastamiseks tegema peavad, see selgub kuival maal.

programme.title: Alvin ja koopaoravad
programme.desc: Laulukirjutaja Dave Seville (Jason Lee) on meeleheitel, sest teda kimbutavad lakkamatult kolm koopaoravat Alvin, Simon ja Theodore. Ühel heal päeval tekib mehel hiilgav idee: mis siis, kui tema laule esitaks needsamad oravad? Asjal on ka oma varjukülg. Kuigi kolmikust saab tõeline popsensatsioon, mõjuvad nad vägagi laastavalt Dave'i kodule ja karjäärile, pöörates tema seni tavalise elu täiesti pea peale.

programme.title: Jõmpsikate metsikud seiklused
programme.desc: Jõmpsikad mässivad end seiklusse, kus neid abistavad Thornberry'de pere liikmed. Nood reisivad ümber maailma ja filmivad dokumentaalfilme loodusest.

programme.title: Õhtusöök idiootidele
programme.desc: Ametiredelil edasi pürgiv peategelane saab teada, et tema ülemused on korraldanud lõunasöögi külaliste idiootsuse tähistamiseks ja hakkab kahtlema endagi kutse heasoovlikkuses.

programme.title: Superbad: ülikõva!
programme.desc: Hittkomöödia kahest semust, kellel on keskkooli lõpupeo lähenedes probleem - kust saada alkoholi, mille abil julgust koguda, et läheneda oma unistuste tüdrukutele? Ainsaks õlekõrreks näib olevat veidrikust koolivend ja tema võltsitud autojuhiluba...

programme.title: Uus algus
programme.desc: USA 2013 romantiline draama Lavastaja: John Carney Osades: Keira Knightley, Mark Ruffalo, Adam Levine Mis juhtub, kui üksikud inimesed kohtuvad ja teevad koos ilusat muusikat?Gretta (Keira Knightley) ja tema kauaaegne kallim Dave (Adam Levine) on keskkoolist saati koos olnud laulukirjutajad, kes kolivad New Yorki, kui mees saab lepingu suure plaadifirmaga. Aga värske kuulsuse ahvatlused viivad Dave'i peagi õigelt teelt kõrvale ning segaduses ja armastuses pettunud Gretta jääb üksi.Tema maailm muutub paremaks, kui põlualune plaadifirma produtsent Dan (Mark Ruffalo) East Village'is tema esinemise peale satub ja on silmapilkselt tema andest lummatud. Sellest juhuslikust kohtumisest võrsub võluv portree neid mõlemaid muutvast koostööst, mille taustaks on suvi New York City's.

programme.title: Troopiline kõu
programme.desc: Kamp näitlejaid läheb eemale argielust ja üritab the suure-eelarvelist filmi Vietnami sõjast, kuni neid kistakse päris sõjaseisukorda. Jeff "Fats" Portnoy(Jack Black) on ülekaaluline koomik, kes üritab lahti saada oma narkosõltuvusest samal ajal dzunglis uut filmi tehes; Kirk Lazarus (Robert Downey Jr.) on oma generatsiooni parim näitleja, kes on võitnud 4 Oscarit; Kevin Sandusky (Jay Baruchel) on tundmatu näitleja filmipaigas; Tud Speedman(Ben Stiller) on aga poputatud action-staar, kes tahab hakata "tõsiseks" näitlejaks. Nad peavad panema on võimed proovile, et pääseda sõjast ja seda muidugi väga humoorikalt.

programme.title: Hoodie
programme.desc: "Hoodie" on superkangelase lugu täiesti tavalisest poisist, kellel on erakordne parkuuri talent ja õiglustunne. Nüüd on ta juba kaks aastat harjutanud parkuurimist Soufianiga, Brüsseli parima jäljekütiga. Ta teeb seda salaja, sest tema ema, innukas politseinik, ei kiidaks seda iial heaks. Kui kolm naabruskonna last Flo, Basim ja Kenza avastavad Pieteri talendi ja motivatsiooni, ühinevad nad ootamatuks superkangelaste tiimiks nimega tiim Hoodie. Neid ühendab üks eesmärk - vabastada naabruskond ülekohtust.
